notes: Master80 full PR and privileged-runtime jobs are configured, including fresh migration deployment, unit/protocol/security suites, Docker/OpenClaw, browser and platform archives. The normative list introduction covers PR lint, types, units, integration, protocol, migrations and nonprivileged security cases. The workflow schedules them through verify/local-integration jobs. Local execution is recorded, but a GitHub PR-triggered execution is not claimed.

Atomic nonprivileged security-test requirement: the default vitest suite runs policy, API authorization, path/image admission, Worker consent and secret-redaction assertions without Docker or root access. The full default suite passed at the recorded 928-case checkpoint; loopback HTTP listeners need normal local network permission, not a privileged container. Opt-in Docker and database cases are explicitly separate.

Dedicated isolated-runtime CI installs pinned OpenClaw, builds the sandbox and runs denial, media, file, timeout/cancel and orchestration fixtures. Actual local Docker receipts exist. The hosted Linux runner itself has not executed in this task.

Web/API and Worker archive builders include checksums, version and compatibility metadata, file hashes and private-path checks. Current API/web packaging and isolated boot passed on macOS; Worker has its separately dated receipt and awaits the final Worker batch rebuild. No remote multi-platform release, signing or notarization is claimed.

Master82 uses 23 source migrations and explicit migrate deploy, never production db push. Fresh schemas and immutable ledger/snapshot triggers are exercised. Root database commands load the private env without replacing caller overrides. Versioned diagnostics preserve the old strict response contract; this does not prove every rolling Worker/API/database upgrade or a Git commit, which was not requested.

Atomic financial-history invariant: the PostgreSQL ledger_immutable trigger rejects UPDATE and DELETE in the actual append-only test. Refunds/releases add compensating entries; new damaged-reservation tests preserve existing balances/entries through hold/replay rather than rewriting history. These passed in the 285-case integration command.

Master81 local-only endpoint guards, production fail-closed flags and explicit environment configuration exist. Separate real staging/production buckets, databases, signing/pairing identities and provider keys are operator deployment work not performed here. Staging security/payment configuration receives a separate audit; environment labels do not authorize actions.

Atomic Worker environment display: authenticated diagnostics/v2 conveys the server label and seller identity while legacy stays unchanged. API verifies precedence/ownership/revocation; the actual health CLI output test verifies all six labels despite conflicting local env. Worker cache is bound to identity/origin; only404 falls back to legacy unknown, never auth/malformed/5xx. Parent full928-unit and411-integration checkpoints passed these suites. This does not certify separate production infrastructure.

Atomic structured logging: API uses structured logging, Worker CLI/status emits JSON and local audit uses typed columns with job IDs. The status test excludes private diagnostics and sanitizes failure codes. Complete cross-component correlation and every log-content boundary remain separate section83 obligations.

Master84 cloud live/ready aliases and DB/Redis/S3 readiness are exercised. Local Worker health/doctor covers runtime, cloud, sandbox and policy; fresh diagnostic additions are under owner verification. This maps the real call sites without certifying the whole health/control surface from API health alone.

Worker management is CLI plus private local SQLite commands, not an unauthenticated HTTP control listener. Runtime Docker communication uses the inspected isolated adapter. Source has no Worker LAN management endpoint. A dedicated external network-listener sweep has not been performed, so this source boundary is not marked TESTED.
